title: Vegan Seitan Burgers
description: A flavorful and tender seitan burger alternative for a vegan diet. Serve with your favorite toppings!
instructions: Preheat your grill or grill pan to medium heat.
Cut the seitan into 4 equal patties.
In a large skillet, heat 2 tbsp of oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the portuguese port and stir to combine.
Add the seitan patties and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until golden brown.
Serve the seitan burgers on gluten-free buns with vegan mayo, if desired.
Optional: grill the buns for a few minutes to toast them.
